summary: A family needs a building permit to keep its side of a purchase agreement.
realLife: The Nollans rented out their beach bungalow until it deteriorated. Their option to buy the lot required them to demolish the bungalow and replace it.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with family, house, purchase option. A household conversation can turn on what the family promised the seller.

turns.what: The seller extends the option to buy until the commission meets again.
turns.pulledBy: The family obtains a signed extension before the original deadline.
turns.writesBack: The applicant files the new date with the hearing clerk.
